statement: A connection is put back into the pool with Put, and afterwards Release is called; Release closes that idle connection.
fragment: Release all connections in the connection pool

statement: The pool is full and a Get waits; afterwards a Put returns a connection and the waiting Get receives it.
fragment: When the connection pool is full, support for connection waiting

statement: A connection stays idle longer than the maximum idle time and afterwards a Get takes it; the pool closes and discards it instead of returning it.
fragment: the timeout connection will be closed and discarded

statement: A Get is waiting because the pool is full, and afterwards Release is called; the waiting Get then returns.
fragment: Release all connections in the connection pool

statement: Release is called, and afterwards Put is called with a connection that was obtained before Release; the connection is closed.
fragment: Release all connections in the connection pool
